description: The single UI-action format: the canonical envelope plus a ui_actions channel whose items are validated against the host's widget declarations.
contract: library/contract/output_formats.json — THE authority. This file is documentation; its mapping and descriptor are conformance-tested against the contract and are not read at run time.
instruction:
IMPORTANT: Return ONLY a valid JSON object.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
{
  "has_insight": true | false,
  "insight": null | { ...the same candidate insight_v1 defines... },
  "events": [], "variable_updates": {}, "queue_pushes": {}, "facts": [], "memory_updates": {},
  "ui_actions": [
    { "target_widget": "<a widget the host declared>", "action": "<an action it declared>", "payload": { } }
  ]
}

NOTES:
- You may act without speaking: has_insight false with a non-empty ui_actions array is valid.
- Only the targets and actions the host declared for this run exist. Anything else rejects
  your whole response, insight included. With no declarations you may not act at all.
